title: Active learning selects an oxygen electrode for protonic ceramic cells
summary: A supervised DFT-trained model and Gaussian-process experimental loop guided selection of BaCo0.8Nb0.1Zr0.1O3−δ. The publisher abstract reports 2.68 W cm−2 peak fuel-cell power at 600 °C and a separate 500-hour electrolysis test. These are specified laboratory cell tests; the Research Square v1 and journal versions differ in candidate counts and are not conflated here.
ai_technology: DFT-trained supervised model; Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization

evidence.tested: Publisher primary abstract reports BCNZ20 and specified fuel-cell and electrolysis measurements.
evidence.unknown: Version-specific candidate counts and detailed test protocols require full-text comparison; no commercial performance claim.
evidence.ai_role: Supervised composition/property prediction narrows candidates; Bayesian experimental optimization iteratively guides measurement.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
